pairs.rationale: Preparing coffee beans is a narrower coffee subject. Coffee also includes drinking, trade and other subjects beyond preparation.
Coffee consumption is a coffee subject. Coffee also includes preparation and cultivation, which need not concern consumption.
Appreciating coffee flavor is a coffee subject. Coffee includes other subjects, such as cultivation or prices.
Preparing beans and consuming coffee can be related without containing each other. Grinding beans does not require drinking coffee; drinking pre-prepared coffee does not require bean preparation.
Bean preparation can concern grinding equipment rather than flavor appreciation; appreciating a served coffee's flavor need not concern preparing beans.
These distinct groups have exactly the same generated title, Coffee. This checks label equivalence only, not equality of their note sets or paraphrase generalization.
Food ingredients are a food subject. Food includes eating and nutrition beyond ingredients.
Sea salt used as a food ingredient is a narrower food-ingredient subject; many other ingredients are not sea salt.
Sea salt explicitly as a food ingredient belongs under Food. Food includes much beyond sea salt.
Carrots explicitly as a recipe ingredient are a food-ingredient subject; ingredients are not limited to carrots.
Chinese cuisine is a food subject, while food also includes other cuisines and topics.
Indian food is a narrower food subject; food also includes other cuisines.
Chinese cuisine and Indian food may overlap in fusion dishes, but neither complete cuisine category contains the other.
Brisket is a cut of red meat; red meat also includes many other cuts. This judges the ordinary food sense of the actual titles.
Brisket can be smoked or otherwise prepared without a crockpot. Crockpot meat dishes can use chicken or other cuts rather than brisket.
Poultry-based food preparation is a narrower poultry-and-eggs subject. Poultry and eggs also includes keeping birds or egg laying, beyond food preparation.
Making chicken stock is poultry-based food preparation. Other poultry preparations do not make chicken stock.
Making chicken stock is a poultry subject. Poultry and eggs includes much beyond making stock.
Daytime greetings need not refer to the weekend; weekend well-wishes need not be daytime greetings and may be given at night or before the weekend.
Patience can concern waiting with no social-status or kindness issue. Kindness beyond social status need not concern patience.
Satoshi Bitcoin units explicitly concern Bitcoin. Bitcoin includes subjects beyond its unit of account.
A campaign to grow Nostr is a Nostr subject. Nostr includes technical and social subjects beyond that campaign.
